definitions.explanation: A person of exceptional courage, ability, or achievement who is admired for their great deeds. Used for historical figures, legendary characters, and modern-day people who accomplish remarkable things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英雄|えいゆう}だ。
⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{英雄|えいゆう}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Read stories of heroes who left their names in history.

examples.japanese: {英雄|えいゆう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ことわざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英雄|えいゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is a proverb that says heroes are fond of romance, but in reality, many great figures were frugal people.

notes:
USAGE:
{英雄|えいゆう} is a somewhat literary or elevated word for "hero." In everyday conversation, ⟦ヒーロー→ヒーロー：11262_hiiroo⟧ (hero, loanword) is also widely used, especially for fictional or pop-culture heroes. {英雄|えいゆう} tends to suggest a more serious, historically significant figure.

The proverb {英雄|えいゆう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧ (heroes are fond of romance / great men have great appetites for love) is well known in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英雄|えいゆう}⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧ (hero legend)
- {英雄|えいゆう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (heroic)
- ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英雄|えいゆう} (tragic hero)
- ⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英雄|えいゆう} (national hero)
- {英雄|えいゆう}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧ (heroes are fond of romance — proverb)
